leftEvidence.title: The LORD swears by himself to bless and multiply Abraham

points.label: Reason for oath
points.left: The oath follows Abraham’s action in the test.
points.right: God swears by himself because there is no one greater.

points.label: Promise wording
points.left: Blessing, multiplying, gates, and nations are named.
points.right: Blessing and multiplying are quoted in brief.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving sequence, speaker, genre, later interpretation, and each source’s stated limits.

rightEvidence.title: Hebrews says God swore by himself and Abraham patiently obtained the promise

payload.tension: Hebrews preserves the self-sworn blessing while compressing the Event that precedes it.
payload.title: The oath after the halt and Hebrews’ later memory
